title: Efficient Keyed-Hash Selection for ΘCB-R3
summary: The source proposes a keyed-hash efficiency reduction for ΘCB-R3 while preserving its protections, but leaves the required selection and attainability result unresolved.

formal_statement.body: An unresolved construction-existence question for the authenticated-encryption construction $\Theta$CB-R3 is whether its keyed hash function $h_k$ can be selected so that one authenticated-encryption evaluation uses approximately $\ell_a+\ell_m+2$ evaluations of $h_k$, while retaining $\Theta$CB-R3's security and side-channel protection properties. The stated efficiency observation proposes achieving this reduction through a smart selection of $h_k$ but provides neither a selection method nor a result establishing that the target cost is attainable under those conditions.

scope.domain: This concerns authenticated-encryption construction design and keyed-hash evaluation efficiency in ΘCB-R3.
parameters: h_k: the keyed hash function being selected
ell_a and ell_m: terms in the target evaluation-cost expression
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish whether a selection of h_k can attain the proposed evaluation cost while preserving ΘCB-R3's security and side-channel protection properties, including providing a selection method or an attainability result.

citations.label: Beyond Birthday Bound Secure Fresh Rekeying: Application to Authenticated Encryption

progress.summary: The source presents this as a possible efficiency improvement from smart selection of h_k in ΘCB-R3. It gives the approximate evaluation-cost target but no selection method or result establishing attainability while retaining the stated protections.
